<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0283cb924a5e29f22fdf0db60bcaedeab3ead3f3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a61335f93f40294f85d645e4efe8255b5ae589b8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #15403 body and all 4 comments (serial note 5857122314, unlock 5862577206, claim 5863183456, os-dev-report 5865099529); PR #20401 body and its REST file listing (three pages, 215 files, served without refusal; the git three-dot diff against the merge base `ab946560f` names the same 215); the maintainer ruling 5419555720 on #12237 and the `## The rule` section of PR #20170; the 39 check-runs on the head. Everything below is `git show` / `git diff` / `git grep` against fetched refs and REST GETs — nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Surface — right.** 215 files: `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts` (+40/−2), `packages/spec/scripts/lib/root-index.ts` (+4/−1), new `packages/spec/scripts/lib/page-title.ts` (+172), new `packages/spec/scripts/page-title.test.ts` (+170), and 211 pages under `content/docs/references/**`. No `packages/spec/src/**`, no `meta.json`, no authored page, no `description:` line, no `check-generated.ts`, no `build-skill-docs.ts`. Every one of the 211 content hunks is a single `@@ -2 +2,2 @@` hunk: one `title:` line removed, a `title:` and a `navTitle:` line added.
- **The rule, on every regenerated title — right.** Checked all 211 against the rule as landed in PR #20170 and ruled in 5419555720: length 37–46 (rendered with the 14-character suffix 51–60, none over 60), exactly one ` — ` separator, no `ObjectStack` in any title. Before: 0 of 211 in band (3–29 characters, median 11), 6 duplicate titles; after: 211 of 211, 0 duplicates. Rung tally reproduces the PR body exactly (module pages 19 / 102 / 60 / 15, category indexes 11 / 3, root 1). The rule's one declared exception (`getting-started/index.mdx`) is an authored page this diff does not reach.
- **`navTitle` keeps every sidebar label — right.** On all 211 pages `navTitle` equals the removed `title` byte for byte. `navLabel()` in `apps/docs/lib/nav-title.ts` returns a non-blank `navTitle` unchanged, so every page-tree entry resolves to the string it showed before; folder labels come from `meta.json`, untouched. The dev's fumadocs replay (449 nodes, diff exit 0) is consistent with this and is not re-run.
- **Population — right, and the card's count corrected correctly.** At the head `content/docs/**/*.mdx` = 406; pages carrying the generator's `AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT` banner = 211, all under `references/**` (196 module, 14 category index, 1 root), every one in the diff and every one now carrying `navTitle`. The 14 `content/docs/releases/**` pages carry no banner. A looser marker regex also matches `api/index.mdx` and `automation/approvals.mdx`, but only on prose ("Auto-generated from the protocol", "they do not edit") — both are authored pages already in rule shape. 225/405 → 211/406 stands on this tree.
- **No other emitter writes a title into `content/docs/**` — right.** The only other generator `title:` emission in the repo is `build-react-blocks-contract.ts`, which writes to `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`. `build-skill-docs.ts` splices a marked body region of `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` and emits no title.
- **Refusal, not truncation — right.** `firstTitleInBand` throws naming the page and every candidate; `build-docs.ts` wraps both of its sites in `pageTitleOrExit` (named exit-1). Observed, not a defect: `root-index.ts` calls `rootIndexTitle()` bare, so a future out-of-band root title would surface as a thrown error rather than the named exit — the root string is fixed at 43 characters and pinned by the unit test.
- **Gate verdicts, from the head's check-runs — all green.** 39 runs, all completed: 33 success, 6 skipped. The skipped six are the two opt-in `Packed-tarball smoke` jobs, `Console Pin Gate`, and the three jobs of a duplicate `PR Automation` run (36389460863) whose sibling run on the same head (36389404418) has `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size` and `Auto Label` success. Mapped by workflow line: the drift gate `check:docs` runs in `Type Check · source gates` (success); `check-doc-frontmatter` and `check-docs-nav-label` in `Lint & Repo Gates` (success); `turbo run typecheck` (spec's `typecheck` = `tsc --noEmit` + `check:scripts-typecheck` + `check:test-typecheck`) in `Type Check · workspace` (success); the spec `local` vitest project includes `scripts/**/*.test.ts`, so `page-title.test.ts` ran under `Test Core` 6/6 (success).
- **Fixed-word accuracy (the dev's open question, judged as fact).** `schema` (121 rung-1/2 pages): every page documents Zod schemas from a `.zod.ts` with a TypeScript Usage block and per-schema sections — accurate. `reference`: all under `references/` — accurate. `complete schema reference` (11) / `schema reference` (3): each category index enumerates every module page of its category as cards — accurate. Root `Protocol reference — every schema by module`: a module table with page and schema counts — accurate. `property reference` (19 rung-1 pages): 18 carry `### Properties` tables; **`content/docs/references/data/feed.mdx` does not** — it documents two enums (`FeedFilterMode`, `FeedItemType`, "Allowed Values" only) and a const tuple, so `Feed schema — Data Protocol property reference` names a property reference the page is not. One title of 211 misdescribes its page; the remedy is a rung condition or a different rung-1 word in `lib/page-title.ts` plus `gen:docs`, never a hand edit. Escalated in ③.
- **Concurrency fact, not a head defect.** `origin/main` (`df3ba164`) is 10 commits past the merge base and regenerated `content/docs/references/security/{permission,rls}.mdx`; GitHub reports the PR mergeable and clean. The merged tree's `check:docs` is the queue's; the later lander re-merges with `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, as the claim comment anticipated.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` — **right.** AGENTS.md reserves the label for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package. `@objectstack/spec` publishes `dist`, `json-schema`, `liveness`, `prompts`, `llms.txt`, `README.md`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `api-surface`, `spec-changes.json`; this diff touches `packages/spec/scripts/**` (a tsx-run generator and its test, not published) and `content/docs/**` (rendered by the private `apps/docs`). `llms.txt` is hand-kept and not in the diff. No `packages/spec/src/**` change. `Check Changeset` is success on the head.
- `Clause-②: no` — **right.** No authorable key, export or schema is widened or narrowed; the PR body carries the line.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Extra emitter site `lib/root-index.ts` — accepted.** It is the generator's third `title:` emission (`references/index.mdx`, previously 18 characters); leaving it would leave one generated page outside the rule. Same package, same generator run.
- **New module `lib/page-title.ts` and `page-title.test.ts` — accepted.** The claim named "the emitter's tests"; the module is the one pure function the suggested route asked for, and the test runs in the spec `local` project (Test Core green on the head). The test pins the band, the separator, no site name, longest-first ladder order, totality over every declared category, same-name disambiguation and the named refusal.
- **Count corrected 225/405 → 211/406 — verified independently** (see ①).
- **`skip-changeset` — right** (see ②).
- **Typecheck narrowed locally to `check:scripts-typecheck` at the final head — discharged by CI.** `Type Check · workspace` ran the full per-package `typecheck` on `a61335f9` (success); the narrowing was local only and declared.
- **Four derived gates NOT MEASURED locally — each answered by a head check-run:** `check:skill-examples` → `Type Check · consumer gates` success; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` → `Build Core` success; `check:type-check-debt` → `Type Check · debt ledger` success; `check:pm-dispatch-gates` → `Lint & Repo Gates` success.
- **Commit trailers — right.** The three authored commits end with the AGENTS.md model-free pair (session URL plus co-author line). The merge commit `9da41cee` carries the `git merge --no-edit` default that `os-regen-merge.sh` step 1 produces — the repo's own tool shape. No model identifier in the PR title, body or dev report; the PR footer is the session-URL form.
- **Out-of-scope finding (abbreviation casing `Mcp`, `Odata`, `I18n`, `Scim`, …) — not a breach here.** Pre-existing from `zodTitle`; the card keeps those strings byte-identical as `navTitle`. It now also heads the search-facing title on those pages. Carrier none; a follow-up card is the seat's call.
- **Open question (fixed words: land as shipped vs hold for rewording) — answered as fact, decision escalated to the seat.** The words are accurate for 210 of 211 pages; the one exception is `data/feed.mdx` (`property reference` on an enum-only page). Option A as shipped lands that one misnomer; either a rung fix on this PR before enqueue (one condition in `lib/page-title.ts` plus `gen:docs`, held by the unit pin and `check:docs`) or a follow-up under option A closes it. Option B holds all 211 out of band meanwhile. The landing choice is the seat's.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-15403-generator-title-rule`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`

**VERDICT: PASS**
